hero.title: Events

events.title: Startup Weekend
events.description: A 54-hour weekend event where entrepreneurs, developers, and designers come together to share ideas, form teams, and launch startups.

events.title: Pitch Perfect
events.description: A pitching competition where startups present their ideas to a panel of judges and investors for feedback and potential funding.

events.title: Tech Talk Series
events.description: A series of talks by industry experts on emerging technologies and their impact on entrepreneurship and business.

events.title: E-Summit 2025
events.description: Our annual flagship event featuring keynote speeches, panel discussions, workshops, and networking opportunities.

events.title: Ideathon
events.description: A 12-hour ideation marathon where participants brainstorm and develop innovative solutions to real-world problems.

events.title: Entrepreneurship Workshop
events.description: An interactive workshop on business model canvas, market research, and funding strategies for aspiring entrepreneurs.

events.title: Investor Meetup
events.description: A networking event for startups to connect with potential investors and venture capitalists from the UAE ecosystem.

events.title: Hackathon
events.description: A 24-hour coding marathon where teams compete to build innovative software solutions for given problem statements.

events.title: Startup Fair
events.description: An exhibition where student startups showcase their products and services to the campus community and industry professionals.
